data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my tasks","i_want":"to edit an existing task","so_that":"the task details stay accurate","business_description":"The user opens an existing task in the task form, changes its values and saves. The backend validates the update, and the interface reports the result without showing a successful state before the backend confirms it.","business_value":"Tasks can be corrected and kept current without deleting and recreating them.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title cannot be longer than 100 characters is shown"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user enters a title of exactly 100 characters and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and returns success"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns success","when":"the frontend receives the success response","then":"the frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"an update request is sent for that ID","then":"the backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"an existing task with Last Updated Date 2024-05-10","when":"the backend successfully stores an update to that task","then":"the task's Last Updated Date is set to the date and time of that update"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user selects Status In Progress (or Open) and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the selected Status and the task shows that Status in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task being edited","when":"an update request sets Status to Completed","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error and the stored Status is unchanged"}],"edge_cases":["The wording of the error and success messages is not specified.","Editing a task that is already Completed: it is not specified whether the edit form may change its Status back to Open or In Progress. This is an open question.","Updating a task that was deleted after the edit form was opened returns a Task Not Found error."],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["All acceptance criteria are met and verified","Validation rules are enforced by the backend","The interface never shows a successful state when the backend request fails","Automated tests for the update flow pass"]},"fixes":[{"finding":1,"revised_tasks":[]}]}
